name: Pumpkit
description: Reviews Pumpkit hosted MCP tools that publish on the user's X account, queue or change a post that publishes later without another prompt, or delete a Scheduled post. Drafting, revising and read tools keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Guard's Review shows the tool call's arguments, not the post that will publish: a version_id, or an edit that leaves out fields, doesn't show the effective text, time, destination or audience.
Prefer parts over version_id for post_now and schedule_post: the call then carries the exact text, so Review shows what will publish.
get_post takes the parent Post's id, not a Version's: use the Post id from start_post or give_feedback, or find it with list_posts and get_post. If no Post holds that Version, don't call the tool.
Before post_now or schedule_post with a version_id, show the person that Version's Final from get_post, every Part in order, the publish time, and the Community or profile it goes to.

Before edit_scheduled_post, read the post with list_scheduled_posts and show the text, time, Community or profile, and follower sharing it will have after the edit, including fields the call leaves out.
Before delete_scheduled_post, show that post's text, time, and which Parts are already live on X, from list_scheduled_posts. Deleting is permanent, and Parts already live stay on X.
Keep post_now, schedule_post, edit_scheduled_post and delete_scheduled_post on Review: a Scheduled post publishes at its time with no further prompt, and post_now can't be undone.
Drafting with start_post and give_feedback only writes Versions inside Pumpkit and publishes nothing on X.
